mfg1-surface-mock-01-theory-q01.stem: Sample placement and whether it is scratched are also test conditions.
reasons: True is correct. Placement and scratching affect test results.
False is inappropriate. Placement and scratching affect test results.

mfg1-surface-mock-01-theory-q02.stem: The same current flows through each resistor in series.
reasons: True is correct. A single path carries the same current through every resistor.
False is inappropriate. A single path carries the same current through every resistor.

mfg1-surface-mock-01-theory-q03.stem: Red-, white- and green-bar colors alone determine every product's application.
reasons: True is incorrect. Trade names and colors alone cannot identify every product's composition.
False is correct. Trade names and colors alone cannot identify every product's composition.

mfg1-surface-mock-01-theory-q04.stem: Once solids are separated and the liquid becomes clear, it may be discharged before confirmation.
reasons: True is incorrect. Appearance alone cannot establish completed treatment or discharge suitability.
False is correct. Appearance alone cannot establish completed treatment or discharge suitability.

mfg1-surface-mock-01-theory-q05.stem: Adhesion testing may be required even when color passes.
reasons: True is correct. Matching color does not guarantee interface adhesion.
False is inappropriate. Matching color does not guarantee interface adhesion.

mfg1-surface-mock-01-theory-q06.stem: Below the melting point, every coating and bonded joint is unconditionally safe.
reasons: True is incorrect. Melting point is not the allowable service temperature of every component.
False is correct. Melting point is not the allowable service temperature of every component.

mfg1-surface-mock-01-theory-q07.stem: Exhaust-equipment function checks are unnecessary without complaints.
reasons: True is incorrect. The presence of complaints and the need for function checks are separate.
False is correct. The presence of complaints and the need for function checks are separate.

mfg1-surface-mock-01-theory-q08.stem: Check hard-coating sealing conditions against the application and specification.
reasons: True is correct. Sealing depends on property tradeoffs and specifications.
False is inappropriate. Sealing depends on property tradeoffs and specifications.

mfg1-surface-mock-01-theory-q09.stem: Removing outer discoloration eliminates the need to investigate corrosion beneath the coating.
reasons: True is incorrect. Removing surface color does not establish the condition below the film.
False is correct. Removing surface color does not establish the condition below the film.

mfg1-surface-mock-01-theory-q10.stem: Local insufficient thickness can remain even when the average is in range.
reasons: True is correct. Averaging can offset local insufficient and excessive thickness.
False is inappropriate. Averaging can offset local insufficient and excessive thickness.

mfg1-surface-mock-01-theory-q11.stem: Redox cannot occur if oxygen does not appear in the equation.
reasons: True is incorrect. Redox can be defined by electron transfer and occur without oxygen.
False is correct. Redox can be defined by electron transfer and occur without oxygen.

mfg1-surface-mock-01-theory-q12.stem: PVD is a method of immersing every metal in aqueous solution.
reasons: True is incorrect. PVD is physical vapor-phase deposition, not general wet immersion.
False is correct. PVD is physical vapor-phase deposition, not general wet immersion.

mfg1-surface-mock-01-theory-q13.stem: Bubbles attached to a hydrometer can affect its reading.
reasons: True is correct. Attached bubbles can affect buoyancy and orientation.
False is inappropriate. Attached bubbles can affect buoyancy and orientation.

mfg1-surface-mock-01-theory-q14.stem: Parts with the same copper color do not need distinguishing as brass or bronze.
reasons: True is incorrect. Similar color can conceal different materials and required processes.
False is correct. Similar color can conceal different materials and required processes.

mfg1-surface-mock-01-theory-q15.stem: For a hollow item, subtract the cavity from the external-shape volume.
reasons: True is correct. The cavity contains none of the target material and must be subtracted.
False is inappropriate. The cavity contains none of the target material and must be subtracted.

mfg1-surface-mock-01-theory-q16.stem: The work-standard edition and target process are pre-start checks.
reasons: True is correct. A different target or document edition may not apply.
False is inappropriate. A different target or document edition may not apply.

mfg1-surface-mock-01-theory-q17.stem: A highly conductive liquid always has the correct target-component concentration.
reasons: True is incorrect. Other components and temperature also affect conductivity; it does not guarantee target concentration.
False is correct. Other components and temperature also affect conductivity; it does not guarantee target concentration.

mfg1-surface-mock-01-theory-q18.stem: All water-based paints are harmless and need no SDS.
reasons: True is incorrect. Water-based classification does not guarantee all constituents are harmless.
False is correct. Water-based classification does not guarantee all constituents are harmless.

mfg1-surface-mock-01-theory-q19.stem: Checking only the flat surface's appearance may be insufficient to confirm drying.
reasons: True is correct. Recesses can retain liquid even when visible surfaces are dry.
False is inappropriate. Recesses can retain liquid even when visible surfaces are dry.

mfg1-surface-mock-01-theory-q20.stem: Light resistance and wear resistance are evaluated as separate service requirements.
reasons: True is correct. Light-induced color change and frictional loss are different phenomena.
False is inappropriate. Light-induced color change and frictional loss are different phenomena.

mfg1-surface-mock-01-theory-q21.stem: Measuring pH alone reveals every metal concentration in wastewater.
reasons: True is incorrect. pH and individual metal quantities provide different information.
False is correct. pH and individual metal quantities provide different information.

mfg1-surface-mock-01-theory-q22.stem: Changing to a high-conductivity material always solves an excessively thin conductor.
reasons: True is incorrect. Insufficient cross-section cannot be resolved by a material name alone.
False is correct. Insufficient cross-section cannot be resolved by a material name alone.

mfg1-surface-mock-01-theory-q23.stem: Rinsing helps reduce carryover of the previous process liquid.
reasons: True is correct. Washing away the previous liquid reduces carryover to the next tank.
False is inappropriate. Washing away the previous liquid reduces carryover to the next tank.

mfg1-surface-mock-01-theory-q24.stem: All voltage drops in series are equal even when resistances differ.
reasons: True is incorrect. At equal current, E=RI makes voltage drops depend on resistance.
False is correct. At equal current, E=RI makes voltage drops depend on resistance.

mfg1-surface-mock-01-theory-q25.stem: Use a concentration conversion table suited to the liquid's composition and conditions.
reasons: True is correct. Such relationships assume specified composition, temperature and other conditions.
False is inappropriate. Such relationships assume specified composition, temperature and other conditions.

mfg1-surface-mock-01-theory-q26.stem: Convert mA to A before substituting into Ohm's law.
reasons: True is correct. m means one thousandth, requiring conversion to A.
False is inappropriate. m means one thousandth, requiring conversion to A.

mfg1-surface-mock-01-theory-q27.stem: A longer test duration guarantees proportionally longer life in every outdoor environment.
reasons: True is incorrect. Accelerated conditions and actual service cannot be converted by one common ratio.
False is correct. Accelerated conditions and actual service cannot be converted by one common ratio.

mfg1-surface-mock-01-theory-q28.stem: The word dry means no exhaust treatment is ever required.
reasons: True is incorrect. Dry methods may still require control of precursor gases and exhaust.
False is correct. Dry methods may still require control of precursor gases and exhaust.

mfg1-surface-mock-01-theory-q29.stem: Identical average current density need not mean identical local distribution.
reasons: True is correct. Projections and recesses can have different current distributions.
False is inappropriate. Projections and recesses can have different current distributions.

mfg1-surface-mock-01-theory-q30.stem: Anodic-film color alone cannot determine total corrosion resistance.
reasons: True is correct. Color and corrosion performance are separate evaluation items.
False is inappropriate. Color and corrosion performance are separate evaluation items.
